basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old software developer who recently moved to Orange County for a new job opportunity. I love exploring the local food scene and am a big fan of outdoor activities like hiking and surfing. I dislike crowded places, especially during weekends. My online hours are usually in the evenings after work and on weekends. Currently, I'm single and enjoying the freedom to explore new places and meet new people.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for about 6 years. I mostly learned about software development through formal education and self-teaching via online courses and communities. Recently, I've been looking into the real estate market and alternative therapies, which explains my diverse subreddit visits.
